summary: Retest of the 2 issues from iteration 92. Both are fixed. (1) PATCH /passive/{pid} {stato_reg:'da_registrare'} on a registered invoice with payments now returns 400 'La fattura ha pagamenti registrati: eliminali prima di annullare la registrazione'. The UI shows this as an error toast and the status stays 'Registrata'. (2) PUT /contabilita/registrazioni/{rid} on an entry with origine 'pagamento' now returns 400. The linked payment (id, conto, coge_entry_id) and the entry stay unchanged, and deleting the payment afterwards still removes the entry. I ran the full suite once (-n 0): 16 of 17 pass. New finding: a credit note used in a 'compensazione' payment (nc_id) can still be set back to 'da_registrare' (200), because the guard only checks invoice_id. Un-registering works once all payments are deleted. Frontend: PaymentsPanel rows show 'conto 06.0x.001 · prima nota n. X/2026'. The payment dialog works: choosing carta defaults to 06.03.001, there are 4 conto options, the override to 06.02.001 works, saving closes the dialog with a toast, and the new row shows the chosen conto and a new prima nota number.

minor.issue: The guard at server.py L2706 only checks passive_payments.invoice_id == pid. A registered credit note (TD04) already used in a compensazione payment (passive_payments.nc_id == pid) can still be un-registered (200). The NC compensation then refers to an unregistered document. Fix: use the query {company_id, $or:[{invoice_id:pid},{nc_id:pid}]}.

action_items: Extend the un-register guard in PATCH /passive/{pid} (server.py ~L2706) to payments where nc_id == pid (compensazione with a credit note)
